title: L.A Owls
excerpt: The west used to scare me
body:
The west used to scare me
Desolate
Cursed
A place so dry it felt of scorched earth
The wind whispered words
My mind could not rest
I dreamed of the east
the grand concrete quest
I found my way out
And nights grew so long
I created a world that carried me tall
While I braced elements of east so new
I dreamed of the west
My mind searched for you
A place once called home
Joyous
Haunting
For when I go back
The owls come flocking
They flutter through the hills
Feathers breath in the wind
I know this feeling well
Two hearts here exist
To appreciate one place
Is to often be removed
I think of you waiting
Believe I’m waiting too
We stand at different ends
On coasts filled to the brim
When you look at the sky
Know at night I exist
The owl will be there
Even when I am not
But will only make a sound
If we stand in the same spot
